name: Run trace shows the project context that was injected
description: From PR #482, open the seeded project-context run trace through the ?tab=findings&trace=<id> deep link (the id is SEED_PROJECT_CONTEXT_RUN_ID in server/src/db/seed.ts). The Specs read row lists the two seeded documents as 'path · N tok'. Opening Prompt assembly and the specs/security-baseline.md block shows the stored text: the <untrusted source=...> wrapper, the document body and the closing tag. Read-only seeded data (no model call). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).
